answer: Let every identity earn its place through a vault review, not instant registration. It must complete ten tasks over a 28-day horizon while staking 20 POA, and gain endorsements from five unrelated members who each risk 10 POA. A second identity from the same funding graph needs eight endorsements and a 40 POA stake, a third needs twelve endorsements and 70 POA, so each fake grows pricier. Verifiers check funding links, endorsement overlap and task history before activation, and slash endorsers if a duplicate signs twice, leaving cheap copies uneconomic, like an opal checked before it is set.
